title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2611.33707v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill learning has become an important way to improve agent performance. However, agent trajectories often contain sensitive information and cannot be shared across clients, hindering collaborative skill learning. To tackle this issue, federated skill learning (FSL) has emerged as a solution by distilling trajectories into compact skill representations and uploading them to a central server for sharing. However, existing FSL methods typically share skills based on skill similarity without considering their contributions to heterogeneous tasks across clients, thereby degrading agent performance. translated_title: P-FedSkill：一种面向任务异构性的个性化联邦技能学习框架
translated_abstract: 技能学习已成为提升智能体性能的重要途径。然而，智能体的轨迹往往包含敏感信息，无法在客户端之间共享，这阻碍了协作式技能学习。为解决这一问题，联邦技能学习应运而生，它通过将轨迹蒸馏为紧凑的技能表示并上传至中央服务器进行共享。然而，现有的联邦技能学习方法通常基于技能相似性来共享技能，而未考虑技能对各客户端异构任务的贡献，从而降低了智能体的性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了P-FedSkill，这是一个个性化的联邦技能学习框架，包含三个关键组件：本地技能提取、个性化技能选择以及任务感知技能路由。具体而言，本地技能提取首先提取技能补丁（即任务适用性条件和执行策略）以及任务执行相关信息。
tldr: 提出了个性化联邦技能学习框架P-FedSkill，通过本地技能提取、个性化技能选择和任务感知技能路由三个组件，在保护轨迹隐私的同时考虑技能对客户端异构任务的贡献，从而提升智能体性能。
en_tdlr: We propose P-FedSkill, a personalized federated skill learning framework comprising local skill extraction, personalized skill selection, and task-aware skill routing, which shares skills by considering their contributions to heterogeneous tasks across clients rather than mere skill similarity.
